processors.description: Apdex per page load from the Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) with Google's public thresholds: good = 1, needs improvement = 0.5, poor = 0; apdex_score is the average of the vitals the load has
processors.matcher: frontend.type == "web" and characteristics.has_page_summary == true and (isNotNull(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint) or isNotNull(web_vitals.interaction_to_next_paint) or isNotNull(web_vitals.cumulative_layout_shift))

dql.script:
fieldsAdd cwv_lcp = if(isNull(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint), null, else: if(toLong(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint) <= 2500000000, 1.0, else: if(toLong(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint) <= 4000000000, 0.5, else: 0.0)))
| fieldsAdd cwv_inp = if(isNull(web_vitals.interaction_to_next_paint), null, else: if(toLong(web_vitals.interaction_to_next_paint) <= 200000000, 1.0, else: if(toLong(web_vitals.interaction_to_next_paint) <= 500000000, 0.5, else: 0.0)))
| fieldsAdd cwv_cls = if(isNull(web_vitals.cumulative_layout_shift), null, else: if(toDouble(web_vitals.cumulative_layout_shift) <= 0.1, 1.0, else: if(toDouble(web_vitals.cumulative_layout_shift) <= 0.25, 0.5, else: 0.0)))
| fieldsAdd cwv_n = if(isNotNull(cwv_lcp), 1, else: 0) + if(isNotNull(cwv_inp), 1, else: 0) + if(isNotNull(cwv_cls), 1, else: 0)
| fieldsAdd apdex_score = (coalesce(cwv_lcp, 0.0) + coalesce(cwv_inp, 0.0) + coalesce(cwv_cls, 0.0)) / toDouble(cwv_n)
| fieldsRemove cwv_lcp, cwv_inp, cwv_cls, cwv_n

processors.description: custom.rum.web_vitals.apdex_score: the metric the Digital Experience Flow Overview reads (Experience card)
